title: Reading Fine-Tuning Diffs Through Lenses: Model Diffing for Backdoor Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.34758v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce a common scoring system based on token readouts to evaluate weight, activation and output-based model diffing methods for backdoor detection in fine-tuning processes. We also improve existing weight and activation based methods by incorporating the $J$-lens and its refinement, the $J{+}{+}$-lens. We test our setup in experiments where we compare a backdoored model with the base model from which it was fine-tuned. Our results show that incorporating the $J{+}{+}$-lens improves the weight-based method in all our settings, while the $J$-lens improves its ranks within single layers. The strongest single method is $\Delta W J{+}{+}$, the weight difference decoded through the $J{+}{+}$-lens of the base model, which ranks a token naming the backdoor among its first ten tokens in 11 of our 12 settings. translated_title: 通过透镜解读微调差异：用于后门检测的模型差异分析方法
translated_abstract: 我们引入了一个基于token读出的统一评分系统，用于评估基于权重、激活和输出的模型差异分析方法在微调过程中的后门检测效果。我们还通过引入J透镜及其改进版J++透镜，改进了现有的基于权重和激活的分析方法。我们在将后门模型与其微调前的基座模型进行比较的实验中测试了该设置。结果表明，引入J++透镜在所有设置中都提升了基于权重的方法的表现，而J透镜则改进了其在单层内的排名。最强的单一方法是ΔW J++，即通过基座模型的J++透镜解码的权重差异，该方法在12个设置中的11个里将命名后门的token排进了前十。此外，我们还展示了基于输出和激活的方法（如ADL和Diff Mining）在后门模型出现某些情况时很容易失效。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于token读出的统一评分系统来评估各类模型差异后门检测方法，并引入J透镜与J++透镜改进权重和激活分析方法，其中最强的ΔW J++方法在12个设置中的11个成功将后门相关token排入前十。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a unified token-readout scoring system for evaluating model diffing methods for backdoor detection, and improves weight- and activation-based methods via the J and J++ lenses, with the strongest method ΔW J++ ranking backdoor-related tokens in the top ten in 11 of 12 settings.
